title: Exclude room identifiers
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.01.01.01 EP 1, p. 1
proposedRule: Exclude room numbers from qualifying patient identifiers.
needsCoreFeature: Validate identifier categories; banner content is not typed in v1.
notes: Two-identifier banner exists; exclusion of location identifiers is not checked.

title: Label specimens at bedside
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.01.01.01 EP 2, p. 1
proposedRule: Label specimen containers while the patient is present.
notes: Physical presence cannot be established by screen certification alone.

title: Distinguish newborn identities
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.01.01.01 EP 3, p. 1
proposedRule: Use distinct newborn identification methods.
notes: Illustrative naming and banding methods are examples, not individually mandatory.

title: Define critical-result recipients
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.01.02.01 EP 1, p. 1
proposedRule: Define authorized critical-result reporters and recipients.
notes: Atomic policy subitem of regulations.md R2-11; v1 acknowledgment is not evidence of delivery.

title: Control alarm disabling
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.01.05.01 EP 2, p. 3
proposedRule: Define when clinical alarms may be disabled.
needsCoreFeature: Device alarm controls and policy conditions.
notes: Clinical device alarms are distinct from the existing medication CDS alert tiers.

title: Authorize alarm deactivation
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.01.05.01 EP 2, p. 3
proposedRule: Define who may turn clinical alarms off.
notes: A UI adaptation must preserve the authorized-role restriction if device controls are added.

title: Use validated suicide screening
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.08.01.01 EP 2, p. 24
proposedRule: Screen eligible patients using a validated suicide tool.
needsCoreFeature: Eligibility predicate, validated questionnaire and screening result.
notes: Applies to behavioral-health-primary care; screening age 12+. EPs 3–7 also cover any patient expressing suicidal ideation. Disposition gate is a proposed local implementation; depressionScreen/PHQ-2 is not equivalent.

title: Assess suicidal intent
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.08.01.01 EP 3, p. 24
proposedRule: Directly assess suicidal intent after positive screening.
notes: Applies to behavioral-health-primary care; screening age 12+. EPs 3–7 also cover any patient expressing suicidal ideation. This is one assessment component, not a complete assessment.

title: Record suicide risk level
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.08.01.01 EP 4, p. 24
proposedRule: Document the overall suicide risk level.
needsCoreFeature: Suicide risk assessment element and predicate.
notes: Applies to behavioral-health-primary care; screening age 12+. EPs 3–7 also cover any patient expressing suicidal ideation.

title: Record suicide mitigation plan
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.08.01.01 EP 4, p. 24
proposedRule: Document the suicide risk mitigation plan.
needsCoreFeature: Risk mitigation plan element and predicate.
notes: Applies to behavioral-health-primary care; screening age 12+. EPs 3–7 also cover any patient expressing suicidal ideation. Do not equate a documented plan with completion of physical protective measures.

title: Include medication name
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.14.03.01 EP 3, p. 44
proposedRule: Include the drug or solution name on procedural labels.
needsCoreFeature: Procedural label model, content validation and exception predicate.
notes: Applies on and off the sterile field; label-generation proposal, not an existing signOpNote requirement.

title: Include medication strength
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.14.03.01 EP 3, p. 44
proposedRule: Include strength on procedural medication labels.
needsCoreFeature: Procedural label model, content validation and exception predicate.
notes: Applies on and off the sterile field; label-generation proposal, not an existing signOpNote requirement.

title: Include diluent name
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.14.03.01 EP 3, p. 44
proposedRule: Include diluent name unless apparent from the container.
needsCoreFeature: Procedural label model, content validation and exception predicate.
notes: Applies on and off the sterile field; label-generation proposal, not an existing signOpNote requirement.

title: Include diluent volume
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.14.03.01 EP 3, p. 44
proposedRule: Include diluent volume unless apparent from the container.
needsCoreFeature: Procedural label model, content validation and exception predicate.
notes: Applies on and off the sterile field; label-generation proposal, not an existing signOpNote requirement.

title: Include expiration date
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.14.03.01 EP 3, p. 44
proposedRule: Include expiration date unless the hospital-defined short-procedure exception applies.
needsCoreFeature: Procedural label model, content validation and exception predicate.
notes: Applies on and off the sterile field; label-generation proposal, not an existing signOpNote requirement.

title: Include expiration time
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.14.03.01 EP 3, p. 44
proposedRule: Include expiration time unless the hospital-defined short-procedure exception applies.
needsCoreFeature: Procedural label model, content validation and exception predicate.
notes: Applies on and off the sterile field; label-generation proposal, not an existing signOpNote requirement.

title: Use anticoagulant reversal protocols
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.14.04.01 EP 1, p. 44
proposedRule: Use approved evidence-based anticoagulant reversal protocols.
needsCoreFeature: Therapeutic anticoagulation/bleeding predicate and protocol information.
notes: Excludes routine short-term VTE prophylaxis. coagLabs is an adjacent v1 panel, not a reversal protocol; existingInSpec=false.

title: Provide written discharge medications
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.14.05.01 EP 4, p. 45
proposedRule: Provide written medication information at discharge or outpatient encounter end.
notes: dischargeMedRec is captured in v1; delivery of a written list is not established by that field alone.

title: Maintain prohibited abbreviation rules
citation: Joint Commission public Do Not Use List page; IM.02.02.01 EPs 2–3; public explanation of IM.02.02.01
proposedRule: Apply the hospital prohibited-abbreviation list to medication documentation.
notes: Related to R2-10; public landing page verified. Dynamic FAQ body did not render; individual examples below are verified from the official ISMP PDF.

title: Spell out international units
citation: ISMP List of Error-Prone Abbreviations, Symbols, and Dose Designations (2024); Abbreviations for Doses/Measurement Units
proposedRule: Use international units instead of IU.
notes: Atomic expansion of R2-10; ISMP guidance, binding=false. Preserve full-token matching rather than banning letters inside words.

title: Spell out daily
citation: ISMP List of Error-Prone Abbreviations, Symbols, and Dose Designations (2024); Abbreviations for Frequencies/Directions
proposedRule: Use daily instead of QD and its punctuation/case variants.
notes: Atomic expansion of R2-10; ISMP guidance, binding=false. Preserve full-token matching rather than banning letters inside words.

title: Spell out every other day
citation: ISMP List of Error-Prone Abbreviations, Symbols, and Dose Designations (2024); Abbreviations for Frequencies/Directions
proposedRule: Use every other day instead of QOD and its variants.
notes: Atomic expansion of R2-10; ISMP guidance, binding=false. Preserve full-token matching rather than banning letters inside words.

title: Use mL for volume
citation: ISMP List of Error-Prone Abbreviations, Symbols, and Dose Designations (2024); Abbreviations for Doses/Measurement Units
proposedRule: Use mL instead of cc.
notes: Atomic expansion of R2-10; ISMP guidance, binding=false. Preserve full-token matching rather than banning letters inside words.

title: Spell microgram units safely
citation: ISMP List of Error-Prone Abbreviations, Symbols, and Dose Designations (2024); Abbreviations for Doses/Measurement Units
proposedRule: Use mcg instead of the microgram symbol.
notes: Atomic expansion of R2-10; ISMP guidance, binding=false. Preserve full-token matching rather than banning letters inside words.

title: Disambiguate discharge and discontinue
citation: ISMP List of Error-Prone Abbreviations, Symbols, and Dose Designations (2024); Abbreviations for Frequencies/Directions
proposedRule: Write discharge or discontinue explicitly instead of D/C.
notes: Atomic expansion of R2-10; ISMP guidance, binding=false. Preserve full-token matching rather than banning letters inside words.
